definition: the usual order of activities you do each day
example: My morning routine starts with breakfast.

definition: a person who helps another person
example: The shop helper showed me where the notebooks were.

definition: a drawing that shows where places are
example: We used a map to find the station.

definition: something you ask when you want information
example: Please ask your teacher if you have a question.

definition: to relax or stop working for a time
example: You should rest when you feel tired.

definition: without dirt or harmful substances
example: Clean water is important for every family.

definition: the flat surface on a phone or computer that shows images
example: The picture is bright on this screen.

definition: a person who lives near you
example: Our neighbour grows flowers in front of her house.

definition: a time when people come together to discuss something
example: The team has a meeting every Monday.

definition: to arrange to have a seat, room or service later
example: We need to reserve a room for two nights.

definition: an area of study at school
example: Science was my favourite subject at school.

definition: good for your body
example: A healthy breakfast gives you energy.

definition: to process used materials so they can be used again
example: We recycle paper and plastic at home.

definition: to copy a file from the internet to a device
example: You can download the lesson to your phone.

definition: easy and suitable for a particular situation
example: Online shopping is convenient for busy families.

definition: the latest time by which something must be finished
example: We must finish the report before the deadline.

definition: the place where someone is going
example: Da Nang is a popular holiday destination.

definition: careful study to discover new facts
example: Her research focuses on language learning.

definition: a sign that someone may have an illness
example: A sore throat is a common cold symptom.

definition: harmful substances in the air, water or land
example: Public transport can help reduce pollution.

definition: a machine or piece of equipment made for a purpose
example: This device measures temperature accurately.

definition: able to continue without causing serious harm
example: The city is investing in sustainable housing.

definition: to work together to achieve something
example: The departments collaborate on major projects.

definition: a plan showing the places and times of a journey
example: Our itinerary includes three cities.

definition: the subjects included in a course of study
example: The curriculum includes practical communication tasks.

definition: the state of being comfortable, healthy and happy
example: Regular breaks support employee wellbeing.

definition: the variety of living things in an environment
example: The reserve protects local biodiversity.

definition: using new ideas or methods
example: The company developed an innovative learning platform.

definition: the ability to recover after difficulty
example: Community resilience grew after neighbours supported one another.

definition: to give a task or responsibility to another person
example: Effective managers delegate tasks clearly.

definition: creating a strong feeling of being involved in an experience
example: The museum offers an immersive history experience.

definition: the theory and practice of teaching
example: The course introduces modern language pedagogy.

definition: intended to stop a problem or illness before it happens
example: Preventative care can reduce long-term health costs.

definition: to make a harmful effect less serious
example: Wetlands help mitigate the effects of flooding.

definition: able to work with another system or product
example: Interoperable systems make data easier to share.

definition: present or found almost everywhere
example: Digital payments are now ubiquitous in urban life.

definition: payment for work or a service
example: The role offers competitive remuneration.

definition: a strong desire to travel
example: Her wanderlust led her to explore remote islands.

definition: having or showing deep knowledge
example: The lecturer gave an erudite analysis of the novel.

definition: the presence of more than one medical condition
example: The study examined age and comorbidity together.

definition: caused or influenced by human activity
example: The report measures anthropogenic changes to the coastline.

definition: the removal of an intermediary from a process or supply chain
example: Digital platforms have accelerated disintermediation in some markets.
